note: PLAN-AUDIO-MATCHING-PREWORK §11.2 cross-stack parity fixture. A small candidate matrix PRODUCED BY CORE (couple pair over a synthetic session, seed 7: one video, a matching external, an unrelated external) plus two hand-authored edge cells that pin the boolean contract. Both the Rust CLI resolver and CoupleKit decode EVERY field; the flag-ON pre-filter reads `prefilterCandidate`, the legacy gate reads `legacyCandidate`/`z` — never a local numeric threshold. The two booleans DIVERGE on the `unrelated` and `short_genuine` cells (legacyCandidate=false while prefilterCandidate=true), which is exactly what makes this a parity test rather than a tautology.
